description: Initialization only: Start with ascending task IDs; choose the highest-profit pairwise swap in each pass, including non-improving moves. Forbid a swapped task pair for the next three iterations; a tabu move is eligible if it improves the global best. Return the best issued trial when no eligible move remains or the evaluation limit is reached. Reassignment is not implemented.
Purpose: Discourage immediate reversal of recent exchanges while allowing aspiration for a new best.
